synonyms: モルフォニケーション
description:
A special 2-episode animation featuring Morfonica!

The Morfonica members are excited for the concert-packed summer vacation. Meanwhile, Toko secretly plans what she calls the "Summer Morfonica Plan" with Nanami and Tsukushi.

(Source: YouTube Description)

Note: Announced at Bandori Channel☆'s Day 1 "Garupa 5th Anniversary Fan Festa in Akihabara" live stream.

node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and is the bassist of the band Morfonica.

A somewhat peculiar girl who longs to be normal. She worries about standing out and hides her true self in order to blend in.

(Source: Official Site)

__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

A student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the the lead guitarist of the band [Morfonica](https://anilist.co/staff/162066/Morfonica). She handles the band's costumes, and similarly to [Lisa](https://anilist.co/character/128147/Imai-Lisa) she follows gyaru fashion.

A popular girl who gathers people around her both at school and on social media. Cheerful and open-hearted, but those around her are often caught up by her tendency to play things by ear.

__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the vocalist of the band Morfonica.

Mashiro is a quiet and reserved girl. Though she aspired for Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and managed to get in, she was overwhelmed by the talented individuals around her. As a result, she felt depressed daily until she stumbled upon a band. She's also full of imagination and tends to get lost in her fantasies.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the violinist and composer of the band Morfonica.

A talented individual who is always at the top of her class. She has a dry personality and always aims to be on top, as well as speaks in a polite manner. She likes sweet red bean soup with mochi, but dislikes strong-tasting food.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the drummer and leader of the band Morfonica.

A class president who's always full of confidence. Though she tries her best, her clumsiness comes out now and then. She works tirelessly to become a reliable, trustworthy person.

**Height:** 162 cm

Soyo Nagasaki is a first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the bassist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**

Soyo is a very kind and mature girl and she is often compared to an older sister. Due to this, she is often relied on by her peers. She has a habit of fiddling with her fingertips when she's thinking or planning something. Although not outwardly hostile, Soyo can be quite cunning at times.

__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A first-year high school student. Mutsumi used to be a member of the band CRYCHIC, where she was in charge of the guitar. She is very stoic and a taciturn. Her father is a famous comedian called Wakaba, and her mother is Mori Minami, an actress. One of her hobbies is ballet.
